decisions.statement: A trace is read here outside the game rather than inside the game.
No game function is called here.
An entry declares its kind before anything else in that entry is read.
An entry with a field its kind never names is refused.
A saved-variables table carrying a field beyond the trace is kept as found.
A trace the addon never wrote reads back as no entries.
A moment here is the second count the addon wrote.

definition: the dialogue choices the quest addon made, read back and checked
